name: big-bench-list-function-turing
description: A task from the BIG-bench suite intended to evaluate language models' ability to reason about functions and produce correct lists or enumerations. It requires models to generate precise outputs for function-like prompts, testing combinatorial and algorithmic reasoning. Scoring depends on exactness of the generated list entries compared to reference outputs.
reputation: Part of the BIG-bench collection used in research to probe challenging reasoning capabilities; recognized in the community but more niche than mainstream benchmarks.
